result.finding: Assessed 6 CWE rules in Concurrency & Synchronization: 3 FOUND, 3 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Scanned application source files for concurrency & synchronization patterns

values.name: Use of Singleton Pattern Without Synchronization in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product uses the singleton pattern when creating a resource within a multithreaded environment.

values.name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

evidence.explanation: FlaggedQueueAction declares two non-thread-safe static fields without synchronization: DATE_FORMAT (SimpleDateFormat, line 14) and MONEY_FORMAT (DecimalFormat, line 13). These fields are accessed by DATE_FORMAT.format() at line 44 and MONEY_FORMAT.format() at line 47, both inside the execute() method. In a servlet/Struts 2 environment, multiple request-handler threads invoke execute() concurrently and share these static instances, causing race conditions that corrupt the internal state of SimpleDateFormat and DecimalFormat (both documented as not thread-safe). TransactionDetailAction has the same pattern with DATE_FORMAT at line 9, used at line 45.

values.name: Improper Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes multiple threads or processes to allow temporary access to a shared resource that can only be exclusive to one process at a time, but it does not properly synchronize these actions, which might cause simultaneous accesses of this resource by multiple threads or processes.

evidence.explanation: The static fields MONEY_FORMAT (DecimalFormat) and DATE_FORMAT (SimpleDateFormat) in FlaggedQueueAction and the DATE_FORMAT field in TransactionDetailAction are shared resources that must be accessed exclusively by one thread at a time due to their non-thread-safe internal calendar/number-buffer state. No synchronization mechanism (synchronized block, ReentrantLock, or ThreadLocal) guards access to these fields, leading to improper concurrent access.

values.name: Improper Locking
values.description: The product does not properly acquire or release a lock on a resource, leading to unexpected resource state changes and behaviors.

values.name: Missing Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

evidence.explanation: The static SimpleDateFormat DATE_FORMAT (FlaggedQueueAction line 14, TransactionDetailAction line 9) and static DecimalFormat MONEY_FORMAT (FlaggedQueueAction line 13) are accessed concurrently in a web application where multiple threads invoke execute() simultaneously. There is no synchronization whatsoever — no synchronized block, no ThreadLocal wrapper, no lock — around calls to DATE_FORMAT.format() and MONEY_FORMAT.format().

values.name: Incorrect Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner, but it does not correctly synchronize access to the resource.
